title: Forgive Our Sins as We Forgive

sections.name: Verse 1
lines: You taught us, Lord, to pray;
But You alone can grant us grace
To live the words we say.

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: How can Your pardon reach and bless
That broods on wrongs and will not let

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: In blazing light Your cross reveals
How trifling others' debts to us;
How great our debt to You!

sections.name: Verse 4
lines: Lord, cleanse the depths within our souls
Our lives will spread Your peace.
